summary: Verified v2 Kanban height fix: `h-[520px]` HARD fixed height on /app/frontend/src/modules/test/DiagnosticsQueueBoard.js. Seeded 8 waiting tokens (Scroll-Test-1..8) via direct MongoDB into tenant-sound-clinic-blr. All 5 acceptance criteria PASS on Desktop 1920x1080 and Mobile 375x844. Test data cleaned up.

acceptance_results.1_uniform_520px_all_columns_desktop: PASS — waiting/checked_in/in_progress/completed all measured exactly 520px height (width 372px each). getBoundingClientRect().height === 520 for every column.
acceptance_results.2_inner_scroll_engages_with_8_cards: PASS — .dq-col-scroll inside waiting: scrollHeight=1216, clientHeight=472, canScroll=true. Programmatic scrollTop=200 read back as 200.
acceptance_results.3_card_size_unchanged: PARTIAL — cards in waiting measure 107.75px each (9 cards visible/scrolling). Not compressed (spec said UNCHANGED which is confirmed vs prior iterations), but slightly above the 75–100px range mentioned in the request. Nothing was actually changed in card CSS between iter_63 and iter_64, so this is the natural card size when it renders name+meta+chips+CTA row. Flagging as informational, not a bug.
acceptance_results.4_empty_column_placeholder: PASS — in_progress column height=520px with dashed 'No patients in this stage.' placeholder rendered.
acceptance_results.5_mobile_375px: PASS — all 4 columns exactly 520px tall at 375x844 viewport (previous `md:` prefix was removed, so cap now applies unconditionally as intended). No layout breakage; columns stack vertically.

critical_code_review_comments: Card height ~108px vs spec's stated ~85px — not a regression from iter_63, just an inaccurate note in the review request. If the intent is truly 5 fully-visible cards, current dimensions yield ~4 fully visible + 1 partial before scroll. Consider tightening card padding or bumping column height to 560px if 5 fully-visible cards is the actual UX goal.
seed_data_creation: 8 Scroll-Test-* patients + 8 waiting tokens inserted directly into MongoDB (db.patients, db.tokens). All cleaned up post-test (8+8 deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The h-[520px] hard cap works across desktop and mobile. Card natural height is ~108px (not 85px as request claimed) — the column shows ~4 full cards + partial 5th before scrolling. If UX wants 5 fully visible, either increase to h-[560px] or reduce card padding. Seeder at /tmp/seed_kanban.py {seed|cleanup}.
rca of the issue: N/A — UX height cap enhancement verified working.
